title: Page 10
lines: 汪袭绿不笨，打瞧着褚靖南和三个表哥都混进了营来，她便知道这几个男人今晚肯定有行动。
她虽然很好奇外头出了什么事，却依然不动如山的端坐着。
她信他无论如何都不会让她身陷险境，一如他信她一般。
可惜她有这样的定力，半屏和紫云却没有，两人一惊一乍的，倒将气氛弄得更紧张了些。
就在火光渐渐灭去之际，帐外又传来一阵刀剑相击的声响，可汪袭绿依然端坐不动。
“小姐，你不担心吗？”半屏忍不住问。
这事不但关乎着粮草，更关乎着老将军、大将军和几个表少爷的性命，怎么小姐这样气定神闲的？
“不担心，因为他说他要同我一起去接宝儿团聚的。”
“可是……”凡事总有万一，万一将军的计划出了岔子，那可怎么是好？
“没啥可是的。”
这话倒不是出自汪袭绿的口中，而是掀帘而入的裙靖南。
“大将军的鳖捉着了吗？”
“自然是该捉的都捉了！”笔直地走到汪袭绿面前，褚靖南牵起她的手，豪情万丈的说道：“走，让你瞧瞧爷杀鳖去。”
“这种事，该我这个女人瞧吗？”睨了他一眼，汪袭绿有些娇嗔的说着，可脚步却完全没停下来。
他来接她，其实只代表着一种意思，那便是他知道她要的是什么，她不想要那后院里四四方方的天空，只想要与他比肩同行。
含笑跟着褚靖南的步伐来到了外头，汪袭绿便见以赵修缘为首的几十个黑衣装扮的人被压制在地。
一见他俩连袂而出，赵修缘就迫不及待的吼道：“褚靖南，你凭什么捉我！”
“就凭你胆敢再动这些粮草的歪主意，便是杀了你，也不会有人说什么。”
“我哪有动什么歪主意，我这是带着人手来保护这些粮草的。”显然那赵修缘够无耻，将这睁着眼说瞎话的功夫练了个十成十。
“好一个保护粮草，我倒是想问问你，为何护粮草可以护得满手桐油？又为何要黑衣示人？”
“这……”赵修缘哑口无言，但旋即念头一转，又低吼道：“我这……”
“你该不会是要说你是想诱敌深入吧？”站在一旁的江成玉瞧了一会戏，忍不住插嘴道。
“对，我就是这样想的！”赵修缘当然也知道自己的话无法使人信服，可是为了保住小叩，他得拖时间啊！
相信云泸的将军若是得了他好不容易觑空送出的信，绝对不会坐失先机，一旦云泸的大军临城，他就有了生机。
“你不是这样想的，你想的是拖延时间，以为云泸的人会举兵前来，你就可以趁乱逃走。”江成玉冷冷的道。
“你、你怎么知道？”赵修缘满脸不敢置信。
“我们自然知道，因为今儿个我们在东边林子不小心射死了一个小兵，他怀中刚刚好有你的亲笔信，正好可以呈给皇上御览，再顺便判你赵家一个满门抄斩，还有，你以为你方才烧的真的是粮草吗？那些真的粮草早就被我们换走了。”江成玉一桩桩、一件件地说得很欢快。
赵修缘的脸色愈来愈灰白，心也愈来愈沉了。
“还有一件事，你送到京城的信同样也没送到那个什么好姨娘的手中，因为前两天我觉着无聊，射着天空的鸟儿玩，不小心把送信的那只鸽子给射了下来，又不小心把那封信给看了，然后不小心把信给烧了，所以她当然来不及逃，听说她不巧被发现怀了身孕，也正好众人都知道这几年褚靖南都没进过她的房，所以不守妇道的她已经让人关押了起来。”
因为奇奇怪怪的朋友多，所以江成玉打探起消息来也特别的快，自然知道许多不为人知的秘密。
闻言，想起数月前他找理由回京，和林好之间的浓情密意，赵修缘仿佛在瞬间失去了力气。
果真是人算不如天算吗？
他机关算尽，以为能为自己和自己的女人争来荣华富贵，但却没想到褚靖南会为人所救，然后将所有的局势都翻转了过来。
深知自己必死无疑，赵修缘抬头怒瞪着汪袭绿，若非是她，他怎会败得那么惨？而这个女人也是害得阿好不幸的罪魁祸首，他要杀了她！
“你别得意，别以为褚靖南会因此专宠你一人，他……”
赵修缘话没说完，便已使尽最后的力气，出其不意地摆脱了制伏他的人，朝着汪袭绿袭去，那速度快得让人措手不及。
眼见着赵修缘握着不知从何而来的匕首，笔直地朝着汪袭绿的心窝处刺去，在千钧一发之际，褚靖南一手横出，不闪不避地任由匕首刺穿了掌心，喷洒而出的血花蒙了赵修缘的眼，褚靖南一脚毫不留情地朝着他的心窝处踹去，下一瞬，原本还凶神恶煞的赵修缘便已经直挺挺地躺在了地上。
这样的变故发生得太快，汪袭绿惊喘了一口气才回过神来，她忙不迭地捧着褚靖南的手，看着那个血窟窿，一颗心疼得几乎喘不过气来。
可偏偏受了伤的男人却不在意，用没受伤的那只手牵着她，便要往营外走去。
“你不包扎伤口，要去哪儿？”初时，汪袭绿当真楞楞地被他拖了几步，直到耳边传来了众人的窃窃私语，她这才回神问道。
“咱们去接儿子！”
汪袭绿愕然地瞪着褚靖南，当真不知道自己是该哭还是该笑，伸手，扯住了他的衣袖，但却阻止不了他，她终于微怒娇喝道：“褚靖南，你若是胆敢让你的手废了，就别想我会回到你身边！”
这样的威胁果然有效，只见原本走得虎虎生风的裙靖南蓦地顿住，毫不停留地又往回走去。“走，找军医去！”
汪袭绿没好气地瞪着他，终究什么都没说，乖乖地任由他拉着去找军医。
一旁的江家三兄弟看到这景象更是双眼瞪大，眼珠子好似都要掉出来了，面面相觑了一会儿，这才相偕离去，看将军那样子，以后他们三兄弟要轮到抱一抱宝儿，只怕有些难度，还不如趁现在赶紧再多抱抱。
两年后。
汪袭绿坐在马车里，怀里抱着已经不太肯安分待在大人身边的宝儿，透着窗子瞧着京城街道上的人来人往，莫名有种恍若隔世的感觉。
朝廷里三皇子通敌倒台，褚家里林好也没了好下场，但最令她感慨的仍是褚镇南为她做的一切。
她还以为她再也不能光明正大的回到京城，更不可能光明正大的带着宝儿再进褚家大门，却没想到褚靖南为了让她能被皇上免罪，花了两年时光禅精竭虑，打得云泸大军连连后退几百里，替皇朝争回了一大片的疆土。
当捷报到了皇上的手中，同时还带了一份奏折，言明了当年因他之过，逼得发妻诈死，如今他立得大功，万事不求，只求皇上能够恩赦妻子。
对于一个千古功臣，龙心大悦的皇上又怎么可能拒绝他这一个小小的要求，当下圣旨一下，汪袭绿不但死而复生，而且还得了一品诰命。
如今大军班师回朝，她自然也就带着宝儿跟着褚靖南回到了京城。
当马车在将军府停下，那亮灿灿的朱漆红门大开，褚靖南的娘亲领着府中众人立于门前迎接。
褚靖南俐落地飞身下马，褚夫人都还来不及好好看看儿子的样子，就见儿子几个大步到了马车前，亲自开了车门，准备迎妻子下车。
眼见儿子做出这种不振夫纲的举动，向来不喜汪袭绿的褚夫人自然脸色一沉，原本雀跃的心情便被厚厚的阴霾给掩住。
content_en:
Wang Xilu was not stupid. When she saw that Chu Jingnan and his three cousins ​​had sneaked into the camp, she knew that these men must be doing something tonight.
Although she was curious about what was going on outside, she still sat motionless.
She believed that he would never put her in danger no matter what, just as he believed in her.
It's a pity that she has such determination, but Banping and Ziyun don't. The two of them were startled, which made the atmosphere even more tense.
Just as the fire gradually died down, there was another sound of swords clashing outside the tent, but Wang Xilu still sat motionless.
"Miss, aren't you worried?" Banping couldn't help but ask.
This matter is not only about food and grass, but also about the lives of the old general, the great general and several young cousins. Why is the lady so calm and relaxed?
"Don't worry, because he said he would go with me to pick up Bao'er and reunite him."
"But..." There is always a chance in everything. What if the general's plan goes wrong?
"Nothing to worry about."
These words did not come from Wang Xilu's mouth, but from Qu Jingnan who opened the curtain and entered.
"Have you caught the general's turtle?"
"Of course we have caught everything that should be caught!" Chu Jingnan walked straight up to Wang Xilu, took her hand, and said with great pride: "Let's go, let you watch me kill turtles."
"Should I, a woman, see this kind of thing?" Wang Xilu said coquettishly after glancing at him, but she didn't stop at all.
The fact that he came to pick her up only meant one thing, that is, he knew what she wanted. She didn't want the square sky in the backyard, she just wanted to walk side by side with him.
With a smile, he followed Chu Jingnan's steps to the outside. Wang Xilu saw dozens of people dressed in black headed by Zhao Xiuyuan being suppressed to the ground.
As soon as he saw the two of them coming out together, Zhao Xiuyuan couldn't wait to shout: "Chu Jingnan, why do you catch me!"
"Just because you dare to mess with these crooked ideas, even if I kill you, no one will say anything."
"I didn't have any crooked ideas. I am here to protect this food and grass with my own hands." Apparently Zhao Xiuyuan was shameless enough and had perfected the skill of telling lies with his eyes open.
"What a good protector of food and grass. I would like to ask you, why can the food-protecting grass protect your hands full of tung oil? And why do you wear black clothes to show others?"
"This..." Zhao Xiuyuan was speechless, but then he changed his mind and roared: "I..."
"Are you trying to say that you want to lure the enemy in?" Jiang Chengyu, who was standing aside, watched the show for a while and couldn't help but interject.
"Yes, that's what I think!" Of course Zhao Xiuyuan knew that his words were unconvincing, but in order to keep Xiaoke, he had to buy time!
I believe that if Yun Lu's general gets the letter he finally sent in vain, he will never miss the opportunity. Once Yun Lu's army approaches the city, he will have a chance to survive.
"That's not what you think. What you want is to delay, thinking that Yunlu's people will come with troops and you can take advantage of the chaos to escape." Jiang Chengyu said coldly.
"You, how do you know?" Zhao Xiuyuan's face was full of disbelief.
"Of course we know, because today we accidentally shot a soldier to death in the woods to the east. He just happened to have your autographed letter in his arms. He just happened to be able to present it to the emperor, and then sentence your Zhao family to be executed. Also, do you think what you just burned was really grain and grass? Those real grains and grass have been replaced by us long ago." Jiang Chengyu said happily one after another.
Zhao Xiuyuan's face became grayer and grayer, and his heart became heavier and heavier.
"One more thing, the letter you sent to the capital also didn't reach the hands of that good aunt, because I was bored two days ago, shooting birds in the sky for fun, and accidentally shot down the pigeon that sent the letter, and accidentally gave the letter to After reading it, she accidentally burned the letter, so of course she had no time to escape. I heard that she was accidentally found to be pregnant, and everyone knew that Chu Jingnan had not entered her room in the past few years, so she had been imprisoned for being unruly. "
Because he had so many weird friends, Jiang Chengyu was very quick to find out information, so he naturally knew many unknown secrets.
Hearing this, Zhao Xiuyuan seemed to have lost his strength in an instant, recalling the deep affection he had with Lin Hao a few months ago when he found a reason to return to Beijing.
Is it true that people are not as good as God?
He had tried all his tricks, thinking that he could win glory and wealth for himself and his woman, but he didn't expect that Chu Jingnan would be saved by others, and then turn all the situations upside down.
Knowing that he was bound to die, Zhao Xiuyuan raised his head and glared at Wang Xilu. If it hadn't been for her, how could he have been defeated so miserably? And this woman is also the culprit of Ah Hao's misfortune. He wants to kill her!
"Don't be proud, don't think that Chu Jingnan will favor you because of this, he..."
Before Zhao Xiuyuan finished speaking, he had used up his last strength to get rid of the person who restrained him unexpectedly and attacked Wang Xilu. The speed was so fast that people were caught off guard.
Seeing Zhao Xiuyuan holding a dagger that came from nowhere, stabbing it straight towards Wang Xilu's heart. At the critical moment, Chu Jingnan reached out with one hand and let the dagger pierce through the palm of his hand without dodging. , the blood sprayed out blinded Zhao Xiuyuan's eyes, Chu Jingnan kicked him mercilessly towards his heart, and the next moment, Zhao Xiuyuan, who was originally fierce and evil, was already lying straight on the ground.
Such an incident happened so quickly that Wang Xilu gasped in shock before she came back to her senses. She hurriedly held Chu Jingnan's hand and looked at the bloody hole, her heart aching so much that she could hardly breathe.
But the injured man didn't care. He held her with his uninjured hand and started to walk outside the camp.
"Where are you going if you don't bandage your wound?" At first, Wang Xilu was dragged a few steps by him in shock. It wasn't until everyone's whispers came to her ears that she came back to her senses and asked.
"Let's go pick up our son!"
Wang Xilu stared at Chu Jingnan in astonishment. She really didn't know whether she should cry or laugh. She reached out and grabbed his sleeves, but she couldn't stop him. She finally shouted angrily: "Chu Jingnan, if you dare to let your hand become useless, don't think that I will come back to you!"
This threat was indeed effective. Qu Jingnan, who had been walking so vigorously, suddenly stopped and walked back without stopping. "Let's go find the military doctor!"
Wang Xilu stared at him angrily, but in the end he didn't say anything and just let him lead him to find a military doctor.
When the three brothers of the Jiang family on the side saw this scene, their eyes widened even more, and their eyeballs seemed to fall out. They looked at each other for a while, and then they left together. Looking at the general's appearance, the three brothers would have their turn to hug Bao'er in the future. I'm afraid it would be difficult, so they might as well hurry up and hug him more now.
Two years later.
Wang Xilu was sitting in the carriage, holding Bao'er in his arms who was no longer willing to stay peacefully with adults. He looked through the window at the people coming and going on the streets of the capital, and felt inexplicably like he was in another world.
The three princes in the court colluded with the enemy and were overthrown, and Lin Hao in the Chu family met with a bad end, but what moved her most was everything Chu Zhennan did for her.
She thought that she would never be able to return to the capital openly, let alone bring Bao'er to the Chu family's gate openly. However, she did not expect that Chu Jingnan spent two years thinking hard in order for her to be exonerated by the emperor, and fought Yunlu's army back hundreds of miles, winning back a large territory for the dynasty.
When the victory report arrived in the hands of the emperor, he also brought a memorial, stating that it was his fault that forced his wife to commit suicide. Now that he has achieved great success, he asks for nothing but the emperor's forgiveness for his wife.
For an eternal hero, how could the emperor, who was so happy with his heart, refuse his small request? With an imperial edict, Wang Xilu not only came back from the dead, but also received a first-grade imperial edict.
Now that the army returned to the court, she naturally took Bao'er and followed Chu Jingnan back to the capital.
When the carriage stopped at the general's mansion, the bright red door opened wide, and Chu Jingnan's mother led everyone in the mansion to stand in front of the door to greet him.
Chu Jingnan Li landed and dismounted. Before Mrs. Chu had time to take a good look at her son, she saw her sons striding to the carriage, opening the door in person, and preparing to welcome his wife out of the car.
Seeing her son doing such an unworthy act, Mrs. Chu, who had always disliked Wang Xilu, naturally darkened her face, and her original joyful mood was covered up by a thick haze.
